parts.t: Welcome to GLENMORE in Grandview Heights! Beautifully updated 2 Bdrm plus DEN (could be 3rd Bdrm) townhome in one of the most popular complexes! Upgrades include new cupboards, backsplash, appliances, flooring, paint & extra built-ins in the dining area. Upstairs features new flooring, vaulted ceilings, an ensuite with two sinks, and a double-wide shower! The complex features top-notch amenities: an outdoor pool, hot tub, gym, floor hockey rink, clubhouse, and a children's play area. Southridge Academy and Grandview Heights Secondary School are nearby. Pets are welcome, and rentals are allowed!
